en: Caesar Augustus orders a registration, and everyone goes to his own town to be registered.
Joseph, of the family line of David, goes from Nazareth to Bethlehem with Mary, who is expecting a child.
Mary gives birth to her firstborn son, wraps him in strips of cloth and lays him in a manger, because there is no room in the guest room.
An angel appears to shepherds at night: "Today in the town of David a Savior has been born for you. He is the Messiah, the Lord."
A great company of angels praises God: "Glory to God in the highest heaven, and on earth peace."
The shepherds hurry to Bethlehem, find the baby in the manger, and tell what they were told about him.
Mary treasures all these things in her heart, and the shepherds go back glorifying and praising God.
zh: 該撒奧古斯都下令登記戶口，眾人各回本城登記。
約瑟是大衛的後裔，就和懷孕的馬利亞從拿撒勒上伯利恆去。
馬利亞生了頭胎兒子，用布包好，放在馬槽裏，因為客房裏沒有他們的地方。
夜間天使向牧羊人顯現：「今天在大衛的城裏，為你們生了一位救主，就是主基督。」
一大隊天軍讚美神：「在至高之處榮耀歸於神，在地上平安。」
牧羊人急忙到伯利恆，找到臥在馬槽裏的嬰孩，就把天使論到這孩子的話傳開。
馬利亞把這一切事存在心裏；牧羊人回去，榮耀神，讚美神。

about.en: A ruler will come from Bethlehem
about.zh: 必有一位統治者出於伯利恆

about.en: A child born, a son given, on David's throne
about.zh: 有一嬰孩為我們而生，坐大衛的王位

about.en: Matthew's account of Jesus' birth
about.zh: 馬太記載耶穌降生

about.en: The next part: Jesus is named and presented in the temple
about.zh: 接下來：耶穌命名，在聖殿被獻給主

en: Augustus ruled the Roman Empire from 27 BC to AD 14; Herod the Great died in 4 BC, so Jesus was probably born about 6 to 4 BC.
Quirinius is known to have held a census in Judea in AD 6; scholars differ on how Luke 2:2 fits with this.
A manger was a feeding trough for animals, often cut from stone; many houses kept animals on a lower level.
The Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem, first built in the 300s AD, stands over a cave traditionally held to be the place of the birth.
zh: 奧古斯都在公元前27年至公元14年統治羅馬帝國；大希律在公元前4年去世，所以耶穌大概生於公元前6至4年。
已知居里扭在公元6年在猶太地進行戶口登記；學者對路加福音2章2節如何與此吻合看法不一。
馬槽是餵牲畜的槽，常用石頭鑿成；許多房屋把牲畜養在下層。
伯利恆的主降生堂始建於公元四世紀，建在一個山洞之上，傳統認為那裏就是耶穌出生的地方。

en: Magi from the east come to Jerusalem asking, "Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews? We saw his star."
King Herod is disturbed; the chief priests and scribes tell him the Messiah is to be born in Bethlehem, as the prophet wrote.
The star goes ahead of the magi to the house; they worship the child and give him gold, frankincense and myrrh.
Warned in a dream not to go back to Herod, they return home by another route.
An angel tells Joseph in a dream to flee to Egypt; he takes the child and his mother there by night.
Herod has all the boys in Bethlehem two years old and under killed.
After Herod dies, Joseph brings the family back and settles in Nazareth in Galilee.
zh: 有幾個占星家從東方來到耶路撒冷，問：「那生下來作猶太人之王的在哪裏？我們看見了他的星。」
希律王心裏不安；祭司長和經學家告訴他，照先知所寫，基督要生在伯利恆。
那星在占星家前頭領路，到了那房子；他們朝拜那孩子，獻上黃金、乳香和沒藥。
他們在夢中得到指示，不要回去見希律，就從別的路回本國去了。
天使在夢中吩咐約瑟逃往埃及；他就連夜帶着孩子和他母親到埃及去。
希律派人殺了伯利恆兩歲以內所有的男孩。
希律死後，約瑟帶着一家回來，住在加利利的拿撒勒。

about.en: The prophecy of a ruler from Bethlehem
about.zh: 關於出於伯利恆的統治者的預言

about.en: Balaam: a star will march out of Jacob
about.zh: 巴蘭說：有星要從雅各而出

about.en: Out of Egypt I called my son
about.zh: 我從埃及召出我的兒子

about.en: Rachel weeping for her children
about.zh: 拉結為她的兒女哭泣

en: The magi were a priestly class of Persian origin, known for studying the stars and interpreting dreams; Matthew does not say how many came.
The tradition of three wise men comes from the three gifts; frankincense and myrrh are tree resins from southern Arabia and the Horn of Africa.
Herod died in 4 BC; his son Archelaus ruled Judea until Rome removed him in AD 6.
Herod's tomb was found in 2007 at the Herodium, his hilltop fortress about 5 km (3 miles) southeast of Bethlehem.
zh: 占星家原是源自波斯的祭司階層，以觀察星象和解夢著稱；馬太沒有說他們有幾個人。
「三博士」的傳統來自三樣禮物；乳香和沒藥都是樹脂，產於阿拉伯南部和非洲之角。
希律在公元前4年去世；他的兒子亞基老統治猶太地，到公元6年被羅馬革職。
2007年在希律堡發現了希律的墳墓；希律堡是他在山頂的堡壘，在伯利恆東南約五公里。

title.en: Jesus in the temple at twelve
title.zh: 十二歲的耶穌在聖殿裏

en: Every year Jesus' parents go to Jerusalem for the Passover; when he is twelve, they go up as usual.
On the way home they travel a day before they find that Jesus is not in their group.
After three days they find him in the temple, sitting among the teachers, listening and asking questions.
Everyone who hears him is astonished at his understanding and his answers.
Jesus says, "Didn't you know that I had to be in my Father's house?" but they do not understand.
He goes back to Nazareth and is obedient to them; he grows in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and people.
zh: 耶穌的父母每年上耶路撒冷守逾越節；他十二歲那年，他們照常上去。
回家的路上，他們走了一天，才發覺耶穌不在同行的人中間。
過了三天，他們在聖殿裏找到他；他坐在教師中間，一面聽，一面問。
凡聽見他的，都驚奇他的悟性和他的回答。
耶穌說：「你們不知道我必須在我父的家裏嗎？」他們卻不明白。
他回到拿撒勒，順服他們；他的智慧和身量一同增長，神和人都更加喜愛他。

about.en: Three festivals a year at the place God chooses
about.zh: 每年三次在神所選的地方守節

about.en: Keeping the Passover and telling the children its meaning
about.zh: 守逾越節，向兒女說明它的意義

about.en: The boy Samuel grows in stature and in favor
about.zh: 孩子撒母耳漸漸長大，蒙神和人喜愛

en: Jewish men were to go to Jerusalem for Passover, Weeks and Shelters; families from Galilee travelled together in large groups.
Nazareth to Jerusalem is about 100 km (65 miles) in a straight line, several days' walk.
Herod's rebuilding of the temple began about 20 BC; teachers of the Law taught in its courts and colonnades.
The bar mitzvah at thirteen is a later Jewish custom; it is not described in the Bible.
zh: 猶太男子要在逾越節、七七節和住棚節上耶路撒冷；從加利利來的家庭常結伴同行。
拿撒勒到耶路撒冷直線距離約一百公里，要走好幾天。
希律約在公元前20年開始重建聖殿；律法教師在聖殿的院子和柱廊裏教導人。
十三歲行「受誡禮」是後來的猶太習俗，聖經沒有記載。

en: John the Baptist preaches in the wilderness of Judea: "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near."
John wears camel's hair and a leather belt, and eats locusts and wild honey.
People from Jerusalem, Judea and the Jordan region confess their sins and are baptized by him in the Jordan.
John warns the Pharisees and Sadducees and says one more powerful is coming, who will baptize with the Holy Spirit and fire.
Jesus comes from Galilee to be baptized; John tries to stop him, but Jesus says it is fitting to fulfill all righteousness.
As Jesus comes up from the water, the heavens open and the Spirit of God comes down like a dove.
A voice from heaven says, "This is my Son, whom I love. I am delighted with him."
zh: 施洗的約翰在猶太的曠野宣講：「你們要悔改，因為天國近了！」
約翰穿駱駝毛的衣服，腰束皮帶，吃蝗蟲和野蜂蜜。
耶路撒冷、猶太全地和約旦河一帶的人都來，承認自己的罪，在約旦河裏受他的洗。
約翰警告法利賽人和撒都該人，又說有一位比他更有能力的要來，要用聖靈與火給人施洗。
耶穌從加利利來受洗；約翰想要攔阻，耶穌說這樣盡諸般的義是應當的。
耶穌從水裏上來，天開了，神的靈好像鴿子降下來。
有聲音從天上來說：「這是我的兒子，是我所愛的，我喜悅他。」

about.en: A voice: prepare the way for the LORD in the wilderness
about.zh: 有聲音說：在曠野預備耶和華的路

about.en: The LORD says to the king, "You are my son"
about.zh: 耶和華對王說：「你是我的兒子」

about.en: My servant, in whom I delight; I have put my Spirit on him
about.zh: 我所喜悅的僕人，我已將我的靈賜給他

about.en: John calls Jesus the Lamb of God
about.zh: 約翰稱耶穌為神的羔羊

en: The Jewish historian Josephus, writing about AD 93, describes John the Baptist and his execution by Herod Antipas.
Two traditional baptism sites face each other across the lower Jordan near Jericho: Qasr al-Yahud and Al-Maghtas in Jordan.
Locusts were among the insects the Law allowed as food (Leviticus 11:22), and are still eaten in parts of the Middle East.
zh: 猶太歷史學家約瑟夫約在公元93年寫書，記載了施洗的約翰和他被希律安提帕殺害的事。
約旦河下游、耶利哥附近有兩個傳統的受洗地點，隔河相對：西岸的卡斯爾雅胡德和約旦的馬格塔斯。
蝗蟲是律法准許吃的昆蟲（利未記11章22節），今日中東一些地方仍有人吃。

title.en: Satan tempts Jesus in the wilderness
title.zh: 耶穌在曠野受撒但試探

en: The Spirit leads Jesus into the wilderness to be tested by the devil; after fasting forty days and nights he is hungry.
The tempter says, "If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread."
Jesus answers, "People do not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God."
On the highest point of the temple, the devil quotes a psalm and tells him to throw himself down; Jesus answers, "Do not put the Lord your God to the test."
On a very high mountain the devil offers him all the kingdoms of the world if he will worship him.
Jesus says, "Go away, Satan! Worship the Lord your God, and serve him only." The devil leaves, and angels care for him.
zh: 聖靈把耶穌帶到曠野，受魔鬼的試探；他禁食四十晝夜，就餓了。
試探者說：「你若是神的兒子，就吩咐這些石頭變成餅吧！」
耶穌回答：「人活着不是單靠餅，而是靠神口裏所出的一切話。」
魔鬼把他帶到聖殿頂上，引用詩篇叫他跳下去；耶穌回答：「不可試探主你的神。」
魔鬼又帶他上一座極高的山，說他若下拜，就把世上萬國都給他。
耶穌說：「撒但，走開！要敬拜主你的神，單單事奉他。」魔鬼離開，有天使來服事他。

about.en: People do not live on bread alone
about.zh: 人活着不是單靠食物

about.en: The psalm the devil quotes: angels will lift you up
about.zh: 魔鬼引用的詩篇：天使要用手托着你

about.en: Do not put the LORD your God to the test
about.zh: 不可試探耶和華你們的神

about.en: Fear the LORD your God and serve him
about.zh: 要敬畏耶和華你的神，事奉他

en: The wilderness of Judea is the dry, rocky land falling from the hills of Jerusalem down to the Dead Sea.
A mountain above Jericho is traditionally called the Mount of Temptation; a monastery has stood on its cliff since Byzantine times.
"The highest point of the temple" may mean a corner of Herod's temple platform high above the Kidron Valley; its exact place is uncertain.
zh: 猶太曠野是從耶路撒冷山地向下延伸到死海的乾旱多石之地。
耶利哥上方的一座山，傳統上稱為「試探山」；山崖上自拜占庭時代就有修道院。
「聖殿頂上」可能是指希律聖殿平台高高俯瞰汲淪谷的一角；確實位置不能肯定。

en: Beside the Sea of Galilee, Jesus sees the fishermen Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net.
Jesus says, "Come, follow me, and I will make you fish for people," and at once they leave their nets.
He calls James and John, sons of Zebedee, who leave their father in the boat and follow him.
On a mountain Jesus appoints twelve to be with him, to be sent out to preach and to drive out demons.
He names Simon Peter, and calls James and John "Sons of Thunder."
The Twelve are Peter, James, John, Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Cananaean and Judas Iscariot.
zh: 耶穌在加利利海邊，看見漁夫西門和他的兄弟安得烈在撒網。
耶穌說：「來跟從我，我要使你們成為得人的漁夫。」他們立刻撇下網。
他又呼召西庇太的兒子雅各和約翰；他們撇下父親在船上，跟從了他。
耶穌在山上設立十二個人，要他們常和他在一起，差他們去傳道，又有權柄趕鬼。
他給西門起名叫彼得，稱雅各和約翰為「雷霆之子」。
這十二人是彼得、雅各、約翰、安得烈、腓力、巴多羅買、馬太、多馬、亞勒腓的兒子雅各、達太、奮銳黨的西門和加略人猶大。

about.en: Andrew brings his brother Simon to Jesus
about.zh: 安得烈領他的兄弟西門去見耶穌

about.en: The great catch of fish; Peter, James and John follow
about.zh: 捕得滿網的魚；彼得、雅各、約翰跟從耶穌

about.en: Matthew's list of the twelve apostles
about.zh: 馬太所列十二使徒的名字

about.en: Luke: Jesus prays all night, then chooses the Twelve
about.zh: 路加：耶穌整夜禱告，然後揀選十二人

en: The Sea of Galilee is a freshwater lake about 21 km (13 miles) long and over 200 m (650 feet) below sea level.
In 1986 a first-century fishing boat, about 8 m (27 feet) long, was found in the mud near Ginosar on its western shore.
At Capernaum archaeologists found a first-century house under a 5th-century church; it is traditionally held to be Peter's house.
zh: 加利利海是淡水湖，長約二十一公里，湖面低於海平面二百多米。
1986年，在湖西岸革尼撒勒附近的泥中發現一條公元一世紀的漁船，長約八米。
考古學家在迦百農一座五世紀教堂下面發現一間一世紀的房屋，傳統認為是彼得的家。

en: There is a wedding at Cana in Galilee; Jesus, his mother and his disciples are there.
When the wine runs out, his mother tells him, "They have no wine," and tells the servants, "Do whatever he tells you."
Six stone water jars stand there for Jewish purification; Jesus tells the servants to fill them with water, and they fill them to the brim.
They take some to the master of the feast, who tastes the water that has become wine.
He tells the bridegroom, "You have kept the good wine until now."
This is the first of Jesus' signs; he reveals his glory, and his disciples believe in him.
zh: 在加利利的迦拿有婚宴；耶穌、他的母親和門徒都在那裏。
酒用完了，他母親對他說：「他們沒有酒了。」又對僕人說：「他吩咐你們做甚麼，你們就做甚麼。」
那裏有六口按猶太人潔淨規矩預備的石缸；耶穌吩咐僕人把缸倒滿水，他們就倒滿到缸口。
他們舀出來送給管筵席的；他嘗了那水變成的酒。
他對新郎說：「你倒把好酒留到現在。」
這是耶穌所行的第一個神蹟；他顯出他的榮耀，他的門徒就信了他。

about.en: A second sign at Cana: an official's son healed
about.zh: 在迦拿的第二個神蹟：大臣的兒子得醫治

about.en: Why John wrote down Jesus' signs
about.zh: 約翰為甚麼記下耶穌的神蹟

about.en: Jesus speaks of the bridegroom and new wine
about.zh: 耶穌論新郎和新酒

en: Village weddings could last a week (compare Judges 14:12), and running out of wine would shame the family.
Stone vessels were used because, in Jewish practice, stone did not become ritually unclean; workshops making them have been found in Galilee.
Each jar held two or three measures, about 80 to 120 litres (20 to 30 gallons).
Cana's site is debated: Khirbet Qana, north of Nazareth, or Kafr Kanna, the traditional site near Nazareth.
zh: 鄉村的婚宴可以持續一週（參士師記14章12節），酒用完了會使主家蒙羞。
使用石器，是因為按猶太人的做法，石頭不會沾染禮儀上的不潔；在加利利已發現製造石器的作坊。
每口缸可盛兩三桶，約八十至一百二十公升。
迦拿在哪裏仍有爭論：拿撒勒以北的加納廢墟，或傳統地點、拿撒勒附近的卡夫爾坎納。

en: At Passover Jesus goes to Jerusalem and finds people in the temple selling cattle, sheep and doves, and money changers sitting there.
He makes a whip of cords, drives out the animals, pours out the coins and overturns the tables.
He says, "Stop making my Father's house a marketplace!" His disciples remember, "Zeal for your house will consume me."
Asked for a sign, Jesus says, "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up."
They answer that the temple has taken forty-six years to build; but he is speaking about the temple of his body.
After he is raised from the dead, his disciples remember this and believe the scripture and his word.
zh: 逾越節時，耶穌上耶路撒冷，看見聖殿裏有人賣牛、羊和鴿子，還有兌換錢幣的人坐在那裏。
他用繩子做了一條鞭子，把牛羊都趕出去，倒出錢幣，推翻桌子。
他說：「不要把我父的家當作市場！」門徒想起經上寫着：「我為你的殿所懷的熱心，必把我吞噬。」
人求他顯神蹟，耶穌說：「你們拆毀這殿，我三天內要再把它建立起來。」
他們說這殿建了四十六年；但耶穌是以他的身體為殿。
他從死人中復活以後，門徒想起這話，就信了經上的話和耶穌所說的話。

about.en: Zeal for your house has consumed me
about.zh: 我為你的殿所懷的熱心，必把我吞噬

about.en: The Lord will suddenly come to his temple
about.zh: 主必忽然進入他的殿

about.en: Jesus clears the temple in the last week
about.zh: 耶穌在最後一週潔淨聖殿

about.en: My house will be called a house of prayer
about.zh: 神的殿是禱告的殿

en: Herod began rebuilding the temple about 20 BC; forty-six years later points to about AD 27, though the work went on until about AD 63.
Money changers exchanged pilgrims' coins for the Tyrian silver used to pay the yearly half-shekel temple tax.
Animals were sold so pilgrims could offer sacrifices; many think the trade was in the large outer court of the temple.
zh: 希律約在公元前20年開始重建聖殿；四十六年後約是公元27年，不過工程一直延續到約公元63年。
兌換錢幣的人把朝聖者的錢換成推羅銀幣，用來繳納每年半舍客勒的聖殿稅。
出售牲畜是為了讓朝聖者獻祭；許多人認為這買賣是在聖殿寬大的外院進行的。

en: Seeing the crowds, Jesus goes up the mountain, sits down and teaches his disciples.
He says, "Blessed are the poor in spirit, for the kingdom of heaven is theirs," and blesses the mourning, the humble and the merciful.
He calls them the salt of the earth and the light of the world, and says he has come to fulfill the Law and the Prophets.
He says, "Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you."
He teaches them to pray, "Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy."
He says, "Do to others what you want them to do to you," and tells of the wise man who built his house on the rock.
The crowds are amazed, because he teaches like someone with authority, not like their scribes.
zh: 耶穌看見群眾，就上了山，坐下來教導門徒。
他說：「心靈貧窮的人有福了，因為天國是他們的。」又說哀慟的、溫柔的、憐憫人的有福了。
他說他們是地上的鹽、世上的光，又說他來是要成全律法和先知。
他說：「要愛你們的仇敵，為迫害你們的人禱告。」
他教他們禱告：「我們在天上的父，願人都尊你的名為聖。」
他說：「你們希望別人怎樣待你們，你們也要怎樣待別人。」又講聰明人把房子蓋在磐石上。
群眾都驚奇他的教訓，因為他教導他們像有權柄的人，不像他們的經學家。

about.en: Luke's parallel: Jesus teaches on a level place
about.zh: 路加的平行記載：耶穌在平地上教導

about.en: The humble will inherit the land
about.zh: 謙卑的人必承受這地

about.en: Love your neighbor as yourself
about.zh: 要愛鄰舍如同愛自己

about.en: The Ten Commandments, which Jesus explains
about.zh: 十誡，耶穌在講論中加以解釋

en: The traditional site is a hill above the northwest shore of the Sea of Galilee, near Capernaum, where the Church of the Beatitudes was built in 1938.
Jewish teachers usually sat to teach, as Jesus does here and in the synagogue at Nazareth (Luke 4:20).
Matthew gathers Jesus' teaching into five long sections; this is the first.
zh: 傳統地點是加利利海西北岸、迦百農附近的一座小山；1938年在那裏建了八福堂。
猶太教師通常坐着教導，正如耶穌在這裏和在拿撒勒會堂裏一樣（路加福音4章20節）。
馬太把耶穌的教導集成五大段講論；這是第一段。

title.zh: 耶穌醫好百夫長的僕人

en: In Capernaum a centurion pleads with Jesus: his servant is lying at home paralyzed and suffering terribly.
Jesus says, "I will come and heal him."
The centurion says he is not worthy to have Jesus under his roof: "Just say the word, and my servant will be healed."
He explains that he too is under authority, and his soldiers do what he tells them.
Jesus is amazed and says he has not found such great faith in Israel; many will come from east and west to the kingdom.
Jesus tells the centurion, "Go. Let it be done for you as you have believed," and the servant is healed that very hour.
zh: 在迦百農，有一個百夫長求耶穌：他的僕人癱瘓在家，非常痛苦。
耶穌說：「我去醫治他。」
百夫長說他不配讓耶穌到他家裏：「只要你說一句話，我的僕人就必好了。」
他解釋說，自己也在權柄之下，他吩咐兵丁，兵丁就照做。
耶穌很驚奇，說在以色列中沒有見過這麼大的信心；將有許多人從東從西來，進入天國。
耶穌對百夫長說：「回去吧！照你所信的，給你成全。」那時僕人就好了。

about.en: Luke's account: Jewish elders speak for the centurion
about.zh: 路加的記載：猶太長老為百夫長求情

about.en: Gathered from the east and from the west
about.zh: 從東從西被招聚回來

about.en: A Canaanite woman's great faith
about.zh: 迦南婦人的大信心

en: A centurion commanded about 80 to 100 soldiers; in Galilee he may have served Herod Antipas rather than Rome directly.
Capernaum, on the north shore of the Sea of Galilee, became Jesus' base; Luke 7:5 says this centurion built its synagogue.
The white limestone synagogue seen at Capernaum today dates from about the 4th or 5th century AD, built on older basalt foundations.
zh: 百夫長統領約八十至一百名士兵；在加利利，他可能是為希律安提帕效力，而不是直接屬於羅馬。
迦百農在加利利海北岸，是耶穌傳道的根據地；路加福音7章5節說這百夫長為他們建了會堂。
今日在迦百農看見的白色石灰石會堂約建於公元四、五世紀，建在較早的玄武岩地基上。

en: In Jerusalem, by the Sheep Gate, is a pool called Bethesda with five colonnades, where many sick people lie.
One man has been ill for thirty-eight years; Jesus asks him, "Do you want to get well?"
The man says he has no one to put him into the pool when the water is stirred up.
Jesus says, "Get up, pick up your mat, and walk," and at once he is well and walks. It is a Sabbath.
The Jews tell the man it is not lawful to carry his mat on the Sabbath.
Later Jesus finds him in the temple, and the man tells the Jews it was Jesus who made him well.
They persecute Jesus for working on the Sabbath and for calling God his own Father.
zh: 在耶路撒冷靠近羊門的地方，有一個水池叫畢士大，旁邊有五條柱廊，許多病人躺在那裏。
有一個人病了三十八年；耶穌問他：「你想痊癒嗎？」
那人說，水動的時候，沒有人把他放進池子裏。
耶穌說：「起來，拿起你的褥子走吧！」他立刻痊癒，就走了。那天是安息日。
猶太人對那人說，在安息日拿褥子是不合律法的。
後來耶穌在聖殿裏找到他；那人就告訴猶太人，使他痊癒的是耶穌。
他們因耶穌在安息日做這事，又稱神為自己的父，就迫害他。

about.en: Do not carry a load on the Sabbath
about.zh: 不可在安息日擔擔子

about.en: Then the lame will leap like a deer
about.zh: 那時瘸子必跳躍像鹿

about.en: Jesus heals a paralyzed man let down through a roof
about.zh: 耶穌醫好從屋頂縋下來的癱子

en: The Pool of Bethesda has been excavated by St Anne's Church, north of the temple area: two large pools divided by a wall.
Four sides and the dividing wall may explain the "five colonnades"; a healing shrine stood nearby in later Roman times.
Verse 4, about an angel stirring the water, is missing from the earliest manuscripts, so this Bible numbers the chapter without it.
zh: 畢士大池已在聖殿區以北的聖安妮教堂旁發掘出來：是兩個大池，中間有牆分隔。
四邊加上中間的牆，可能就是「五條柱廊」；後來羅馬時期附近有一座求醫的神廟。
第4節說天使攪動池水，最早的抄本沒有這節，所以本站的經文沒有第4節。

title.zh: 耶穌趕出名叫軍團的鬼

en: Across the sea, in the region of the Gerasenes, a man with an unclean spirit comes from the tombs to meet Jesus.
No one can bind him even with chains; night and day he shrieks and cuts himself with stones.
He kneels before Jesus and shouts, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God?"
Asked his name, he says, "My name is Legion, for there are many of us."
The spirits beg to go into a herd of about two thousand pigs, which rush down the bank into the sea and drown.
The people find the man dressed and in his right mind, and they beg Jesus to leave.
Jesus sends the man home to tell how much the Lord has done for him, and he proclaims it in the Decapolis.
zh: 耶穌渡到海的對岸，到了格拉森人的地區，有一個被污靈附着的人從墳地出來迎見他。
連鐵鏈也沒有人能捆住他；他晝夜喊叫，又用石頭砍自己。
他跪在耶穌面前，大聲喊叫：「至高神的兒子耶穌，你為甚麼來干涉我？」
耶穌問他的名字，他說：「我名叫軍團，因為我們有很多。」
污靈求耶穌讓他們進入一群約二千頭的豬；豬群闖下山坡，投進海裏淹死了。
眾人看見那人穿着衣服，神智清醒，就害怕，求耶穌離開他們的地區。
耶穌叫那人回家，告訴人主為他做了何等大的事；他就在低加坡里傳揚。

about.en: Matthew's account: two men in the region of the Gadarenes
about.zh: 馬太的記載：加大拉人地區的兩個人

about.en: Luke's account of the same healing
about.zh: 路加記載同一件事

about.en: Jesus returns to the Decapolis and heals a deaf man
about.zh: 耶穌再到低加坡里，醫好耳聾的人

en: The east shore of the Sea of Galilee was largely Gentile, which is why pigs were kept there; the Law made pigs unclean (Leviticus 11:7).
Manuscripts and Gospels name the place differently (Gerasenes, Gadarenes); many place it near Kursi, where a Byzantine monastery was found in 1970.
A Roman legion had about 5,000 to 6,000 soldiers.
The Decapolis ("ten cities") were Greek-style cities, mostly east of the Jordan, such as Gerasa (Jerash) and Gadara.
zh: 加利利海東岸大多是外邦人居住的地方，所以那裏有人養豬；律法定豬為不潔（利未記11章7節）。
各抄本和福音書對地名的記載不同（格拉森、加大拉）；許多人認為在庫爾西附近，那裏在1970年發現了拜占庭時代的修道院。
羅馬的一個軍團約有五千至六千名士兵。
低加坡里（意思是「十城」）是希臘式的城市，大多在約旦河以東，例如格拉森（今傑拉什）和加大拉。
